messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Cyclobenzaprine is a prescription muscle relaxant used short-term to relieve muscle spasms caused by sprains, strains, and injuries, including low back and neck pain. It is used together with rest and physical therapy to help relieve the pain, tenderness, and limited movement caused by muscle spasm. 1,2
Cyclobenzaprine is also used to treat fibromyalgia in adults, where it can help reduce pain. For fibromyalgia, it is taken as a sublingual (under the tongue) tablet at bedtime under the brand name Tonmya. In clinical trials, Tonmya significantly reduced fibromyalgia pain compared with placebo over 14 weeks, and close to half of treated patients achieved at least a 30% improvement in pain. 3
The Flexeril brand has been discontinued, but cyclobenzaprine is available as generic tablets and as the brand-name products Amrix (extended-release capsules) and Fexmid. 2,4
Triplet: ["Fexmid", "is", "brand-name product"]

The relation 'is' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject entity is identified as or classified as the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'is a type of': The subject entity is a specific type or subtype of the object entity.
B. 'include': The subject entity comprises or contains the component or measurement specified by the object entity.
C. 'involves buildup of': The subject condition involves the accumulation of the substance specified by the object entity.
D. 'has controlled substance schedule': The subject drug is classified under the controlled substance schedule specified by the object entity.
E. 'occurs in': The medical condition specified by the subject entity is associated with or found in the group of individuals described by the object entity.
